english: Modissa scoffs.
I'll have to go set this whole thing in motion. Gods know we have enough to do.
Jehanne taps her on the back. "Don't worry! I'll run back and prep the machine!"
Yeah, and I can help you on the copy surface, Modissa.
Good. Hey, Rollo, she says and walks up to him. "Jehanne will come back in an hour to return the documents. You'll trust us that long, right?"
Standing before each other, Rollo looks down at the girl with a question on his face.
Hm? Why are you looking at me like that?
He clenches his jaw and looks away.
I trust you, Modissa.
And, uh...
Thanks for this.
He holds out a hand.
She looks at it, and adjusts her glasses.
She grabs his hand, shaking it.
Now let's go! Skynda, skynda!
The girls leave in a hurry, leaving you with the four shell-shocked boys.
Well.
That's it.
Thank you as well, Cleric.
You've... really changed this city for the better, I'm sure of it.
The large kid pumps his fists into the air. "...Yeah!"
Oh yes, Urth-Nisse mumbles, and sparks a flame with a finger snap.
Cool, the short kid in the back says. "We're gonna be stuck here for an hour, aren't we?"
Probably, yeah.
And, uh... we'll be sure to consider that Urthguard recommendation. For sure.
Let's hope you guys don't mess it up.
Be careful out here, boys.
The lanky kid scowls at you. "...Arsonist? What the hell, man..."
Oh, we would never!
They laugh.
Rollo gives you a thumbs up.
Well, we're gonna be here a bit longer, so... anything else you need?
Make us.
Your companion takes a step back. "Get 'em, champ."
Roll initiative.
Uh- uh- uh, the big kid mutters as he gets up from his seat.
We're doing this?
A flame lights up in his hand.
Weak magic. But still dangerous.
You can't... tell us what to do!
The big one takes a step forward, and gives you a shove.
His light shove is enough to push the air out of your lungs.
GODS BEWARE.
THE BOY IS MADE OF IRON.
The quiet kid looks around, and sees a stick.
I knew this would happen... he mutters, and swings it behind you.
He cracks it over your head.
Oh. Shit.
The lanky kid finishes his attempt at a cantrip.
A Fire Bolt.
PAIN.
He tosses the spark across the room, hitting you in the arm.
Yes!
Your chain mail... is scorched.
You don't get to just come here... and tell us what to do.
You're an agent of corruption. The city doesn't need you!
He steps forward with a roar, and takes a swing at you.
Your head held high.
Looking down at these brash younglings.
They will hear you.
You tremble.
These violent youths surround you.
You must be careful.
Threaten them.
Empathize with them.
No?
Yeah. You do that.
He looks nervously to his friends.
They all appear frightened.
They will listen if you speak.
They fear your might.
But they will still fight against your tyranny, despite how foolish that would be.
The spell fizzles before the blinking boy, as he lets out a surprised scoff.
Was that... magic?
He resisted. How annoying.
Only one thing to do now.
A step towards the blonde kid.
(Grab his neck.)
Guh...! What are you...?
Dumbass!
He stares at you wide-eyed.
You'll all end up in the dungeon if you keep this bullshit up!
O-Okay.
(Let him go.) "Good. Now..."
You have their attention.
The four boys all look at you, fear (and a bit of respect) in their bulging eyes.
Do it.
Guide them to the future.
It's time for you to make a decision.
Now go. Leave! (Make them leave.)
You feel the pressure.
Building up.
Oh gods...
You can't.
Can you?
(Yell at them.) "Stop it! Go home!"
(Begin crying.)
Damn.
What the fuck?
Oh. Is he sad?
I'm sad... about the state of the youth... (Try to contain yourself.)
The blonde kid fidgets, searching for words.
He finds this so awkward that he forgets about the entire fight.
Let's just... go, guys. This isn't worth it.
Uh-huh.
Sorry, Cleric.
The quiet kid just shakes his head.
No, please stay. Just ignore this ever happened.
Okay, goodbye forever... (Let them leave.)
Look at them.
Look at these poor boys, lost in a whirlwind of pain.
Of abandonment.
They're not that different from me.
What does that matter?
You would have been here, if your path was but a little less silver-spoony.
It matters, if you care.
Which you do. On some level.
Show them you care. And it will be good.
Pause. A second.
Oh? You're... you're done?
Do you... give in?
Kid. I know you want to do what's best for this city. I do too.
He lets you speak.
And you clearly believe in yourselves here. But... you need to make a decision.
Are you speaking to him, or yourself?
What decision?
The adrenaline is wearing off.
Each of them- their hearts beating. Legs weak.
They are frightened.
You can let them continue on their search for meaning.
Or grant them a way out.
Or just let them go.
That would probably be best.
Show them the way.
I apologize for the scuffle. You must follow your own paths. So.... continue on your quest. (Drop it.)
Huh?
I will not interfere. But I have some more questions for you.
I've lost all interest in this. Just do whatever.
What the hell...?
You're just going to...
Yes. Ignore the fight. Happens all the time.
That's not good. You shouldn't fight...
It's a cleric thing. You wouldn't understand, big guy.
Uh... we're happy if you're happy?
Yeah. (Look down.)
Rollo looks to his buddies, who all shrug.
Okay. Sure. Uh. What do you want then?
Nice save.
Slightly humiliating, but still.
You have proven nothing but the shrinkage of your manhood.
Be ashamed. Be very ashamed.
The lanky kid gasps for air. "Yeah, what?!"
Go serve your city, Rollo. From within. That's the best way to create change. With my recommendation, you've got a foot in the door.
Your heart is beating.
But you cannot understand these youths.
Unless...
It's the parents' fault.
Always is.
Don't you understand... how disappointed your parents would be, Rollo? All of you!
They stare at you blankly.
If your parents knew how twisted you all were... here in this anti-government radical terrorist group!
He lets out a mocking laugh.
But you notice a hint of... what is that- pain in the laugh?
Are you kidding? he says, and looks over to Nisse who just frowns. "You think they give a shit? They're just as angry about the state of the city."
They just can't do anything about it because... they've got so much shit to do.
We're free, so we have time to actually do something.
Well, be free somewhere else. This is private property. I think. (Make them leave.)
Sure. I get it. (Let them stay.)
I don't think you do.
But whatever.
Are you going to let us be now?
...Yeah. Sure.
Good. Anything else?
The spell causes his eyes to glaze over for a second.
Then he smiles.
Hey, hey now. Let's not fight. We're all on the same side here.
The cleric is our friend. I don't see why we should do anything negative and/or possibly annoying towards him.
The short kid looks between you and Rollo.
Did you charm him? Seriously?
Rollo makes an incredulous expression.
What are you talking about, Toli? Don't be ridiculous.
Sten! Tap him on the back. Hard.
The large boy shrugs.
Then he slams his palm into Rollo. Hard.
The esoteric veil over his eyes instantly evaporates.
Guh...! What the shit...?
Hey! I spent a whole spell slot on that.
Nice counterspell.
Are you calmer now?
Thanks?
You CHARMED me?!
Your goblin companion leans over and whispers, "For once, I don't mind the mind control."
You were out of control. Basic procedure.
Sorry.
I'm not sorry. You had it coming.
The blonde kid scoffs a few times, clearly attempting to comprehend his situation.
Well, we're not fucking leaving!
If you're not leaving, then you have to make a decision about your future...
That's fair. (Let them stay.)
You think some more painful magic could persuade you otherwise? (Make them go.)
Alright. Then... we'll stay.
No more magic either.
Even if it's pretty cool.
But please, Lord Cleric- is there anything else you want to talk about?
He waves his hand. "You know what. Let's just go, guys."
This Cleric is a lost cause.
The lanky kid closes his fist, turning off his readied fire bolt.
The big kid just nods and doesn't look at you.
You watch as the boys exit the rollermill, one by one.
Until they no longer linger among the turning cogs.
Well. You got them to leave. That's something.
E-Right.
I think... you did what you had to.
He's too kind.
